normal.name: Aaron Brick — אהרן בריק
normal.text: “The Comic Book Story of Video Games” by Jonathan Hennessey & Jack McGowan (2017). An exhaustive story starting in the 19th century, emphasizing economics and the effects of WWII and the Cold War. Narration dominates, with almost no dialogue between the many male figures from the US and Japan. Jumps around time and space create several continuity problems. 3pp of notes. Apparently #18 in a series of graphic history reviews. #videogames #usa #japan #history #histodons #comic #graphicnovel #book
